extDesc.message: Only when pasting or dropping images in the Discord channels or servers you specify, a confirmation dialog appears first; after confirming, the image is uploaded to Uguu / ImgLink and the URL is inserted.

modeList.message: Intercept only in channels / servers in the list below

autoConfirmLabel.message: Skip the confirmation window and upload with the last choice

autoConfirmHint.message: When on, images in channels/servers upload directly without the confirm window.

modeHint.message: Not in "list only" mode right now; the list has no effect.

notDiscord.message: Open this window from a Discord or Stoat web tab to add the current channel to the list.

threadHint.message: Threads and forum posts have their own IDs and are not covered by "channel" rules; if you want to cover an entire server, add it as a server rule instead.

statusBlocked.message: ✓ Images on this page will be intercepted (confirm on paste)

statusEmpty.message: ✗ The list is empty, nothing is intercepted right now; use the button below to add this channel

statusNotBlocked.message: ✗ Images on this page are not intercepted; the site handles them as normal

addChannel.message: Add this channel to the list

removeChannel.message: Remove this channel from the list

warnUpload.message: Images are uploaded to a third-party image host, not Discord or Stoat. This extension is not affiliated with these services.

warnPublic.message: Anyone with the image URL can see the image. Do not upload anything you don't want others to see.

warnCancel.message: A confirmation dialog appears before every upload; clicking "Cancel" uploads nothing.

scopeDesc.message: Only pasting or dropping images in the channels or servers you specify will be intercepted; everywhere else sites work as normal.

modeListSuggested.message: Intercept only in channels / servers in the list below (recommended)

emptyRules.message: The list is empty. Open the extension icon on a Discord or Stoat page to add the current channel or server.

urlHint.message:
Copy the current channel URL from Discord or Stoat's address bar and paste it here. Stoat channel URLs look like https://stoat.chat/server/serverID/channel/channelID. DM URLs are /channels/@me/… on Discord; adding "whole server" covers all DMs.
Threads and forum posts have their own IDs and are not covered by "channel" rules; if you want to cover an entire server, add it as a server rule instead.

uguuAnon.message: Anonymous upload; no registration or setup required.

uguuTemp.message: Files are stored temporarily; how long they last is up to Uguu. Images in messages will expire when they are deleted.

imglinkIntro.message: ImgLink's API upload requires an API Key. Please register an account and create one first:

imglinkStep1.message: Register a free account on the website:

imglinkStep2.message: After logging in, go to the API Keys section of the Dashboard and click Generate New Key:

imglinkStep3.message: Paste the key into the field below and save.

privacyHeading.message: About privacy (only people with the URL can see it)

privacyPrivate.message: ImgLink images can be set to "private". According to the official docs, private images are only accessible by URL and are not searchable or shown on public pages.

privacyDefault.message: Images may be public by default. This extension cannot set them to private for you; please do so in your ImgLink dashboard (see the official site for the current UI).

privacyTest.message: Please test one image first to see whether private images display correctly in Discord.

keyHint.message: The key is stored only in this browser's extension storage and used by the background script; it is never sent to the Discord page. Only needed when uploading with ImgLink.

pasteKeyFirst.message: Please paste an API Key first

guildExists.message: This server is already in the list

channelExists.message: This channel is already in the list

badUrl.message: Unrecognized URL, please paste a link like https://discord.com/channels/… or https://stoat.chat/server/…

noChannelInUrl.message: This URL only has a server, no channel; please use "Add whole server" instead

hintImglink.message: ImgLink requires you to register an account and create an API Key in the extension's "Options" page. Images may be public by default; set them to private in your ImgLink dashboard (only people with the URL can see them). Website:

hintUguu.message: Uguu needs no account; files are stored temporarily and how long they last is up to Uguu. Anyone with the URL can see them. Website:

optUguu.message: Uguu (temporary storage, duration set by Uguu)

optImglink.message: ImgLink (API Key needed, see extension options)

modalWarn.message: Images will be uploaded to the third-party host you choose; anyone with the link can see them. Uncheck them or press "Cancel" and nothing will be uploaded.

insertFailed.message: Couldn't find the input box or failed to insert; the URL was copied to your clipboard, please paste it manually (Ctrl+V).

needImglinkKey.message: Please enter your ImgLink API Key in the extension's "Options" page first
